title: Res Nova: Geometrically Ordered Dynamics and Information Tension — μ_std Action, AeST Covariant Completion, and a Reproducible SPARC Benchmark
description: The interpolating function mu_dual(x) = x/(1+x) of the previous version was falsified on 2026-09-12 by the repository's own exact solution of the corrected action: within standard two-derivative AeST/AQUAL it produces an unscreened, r-independent anomalous acceleration ~5.7×10⁵ above the Cassini quadrupole bound, and every GW170817-safe (c_T = c) screening escape route is closed (Vainshtein exponent p ≥ 2.34 vs. the Horndeski cap p → 2⁻). The theory is rebuilt on the surviving branch mu_std(x) = x/√(1+x²). With F_std = ½[x√(1+x²) − arsinh x] under the AQUAL convention F′ = xμ, the μ → 1 − 1/(2x²) tail clears the solar system: an exact 50-digit perturbative solve gives the first corpus bounds on the scalar amplitude, λ_s ≲ 2.7 (Cassini Q₂ quadrupole) and λ_s ≲ 1.0 (perihelion precession). The covariant completion is genuine AeST (Skordis–Złośnik, PRL 127, 161302): scalar field 𝒴 with minimal matter coupling on the V₂(ℝ³) Cartan-trialality substrate; c_T = c is structural rather than asserted, and PPN γ = 1 is derived free-function-independently (all traceless anisotropic stress sources enter at O(ε²)). The rebuilt cosmological sector adopts the published SZ Cosh parameters with an exact closed-form background, |ΔH/H| ≤ 3.6×10⁻³ vs. ΛCDM at the cost of five parameters; non-linear AeST structure formation remains unsimulated by anyone. SPARC 175-galaxy benchmark: a₀ = (1.116 ± 0.161)×10⁻¹⁰ m/s²; the pre-registered a₀(z) test favours constant a₀ over the horizon-tied ξcH(z) at 5.9σ. 17 Lean 4 modules verified (0 sorry; axioms restricted to propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound). The structural uniqueness of μ_std is stated as what it is — a rapidity-conjugacy / chiral-Fisher-identity postulate swap, not a derivation from nothing.
